Ceres Chill — Amazon PDP Image Wireframe

This wireframe maps out the seven gallery images for every Ceres Chill product on Amazon. Each product's images move a shopper from the main image to benefits, details and real life use, in the order they appear on the listing.

How to walk through it: pick a product, then scroll top to bottom the way a shopper would. Each card shows an example image (a third party layout reference only), a short visual description of our version, and the copy for that image. Red lines are required safety notes; yellow lines are details we still need from you.

Ceres Chill OG Plus, 28 oz
